_comment: Ledger of tests deliberately left unregistered for PPU CI. Baseline: nightly run 32644655734 plus per-PR run 32678384225 (2026-08-23/24). Read `category` and `recheck_when` before restoring any registration. `status` is what the CI run reported; `true_outcome` is what actually happened -- they differ for the 12 files the runner mis-reported as passes.
_note_on_false_pass: 12 entries have status=passed but true_outcome != passed. Python >= 3.12 unittest.main() exits 5 whenever testsRun == 0 and skipped == 0 -- even when the result carries ERRORs -- and ci_utils.py counted exit 5 as a pass at the time (introduced in ff138e099c, since reverted to upstream's `if ret_code == 0:`). 10 of them were real setUpClass ERRORs; the other 2 contributed zero coverage. Recorded here once instead of in every `reason`: a reason should describe the test's own problem, and line-number references rot.

baseline.note: The two runs have different heads. 82 of the 83 all_skipped entries and 11 of the 12 mis-reported passes come from the nightly run at 68c039086c; the per-PR run contributes 2 entries (openai_server/basic/test_http2_server.py, all_skipped, and unit/mem_cache/test_unified_radix_cache_bench.py, a mis-reported pass).
